## Walkthrough The changes remove automatic namespace state synchronization from route parameters in two React hooks (`useLegacyDashboardsProject` and `useMonitoringNamespace`), eliminating unused imports and simplifying namespace management logic while preserving core functionality. ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Namespace State Sync Removal**
`web/src/components/dashboards/legacy/useLegacyDashboardsProject.ts`, `web/src/components/hooks/useMonitoringNamespace.ts`|Removed conditional logic that synchronized `activeNamespace` state from route parameters. Eliminated unused imports (`useEffect`, `useMonitoring`). Hooks now compute namespace from route or active namespace without triggering state updates based on route changes.| ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~8 minutes
🚥 Pre-merge checks | ✅ 10
✅ Passed checks (10 passed) | Check name | Status | Explanation | | :----------------------------------------------: | :------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Description Check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped - CodeRabbit’s high-level summary is enabled. | | Docstring Coverage | ✅ Passed | No functions found in the changed files to evaluate docstring coverage. Skipping docstring coverage check. | | Stable And Deterministic Test Names | ✅ Passed | PR modifies only application code (TypeScript React hooks) with no test file changes. Check for Ginkgo BDD-style dynamic test names is not applicable. | | Test Structure And Quality | ✅ Passed | This PR modifies TypeScript React hook implementations, not Ginkgo test code. The repository does not use Ginkgo testing framework. | | Microshift Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | This check for new Ginkgo e2e tests is not applicable; the PR contains only TypeScript/React frontend code changes to remove namespace synchronization logic with no new tests. | | Single Node Openshift (Sno) Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | The PR modifies only TypeScript React component hooks and contains no Ginkgo e2e test code, making this Ginkgo SNO compatibility check inapplicable. | | Topology-Aware Scheduling Compatibility | ✅ Passed | Pull request modifies React/TypeScript hooks for namespace synchronization logic, not deployment manifests, operator code, or Kubernetes controllers with scheduling constraints. | | Ote Binary Stdout Contract | ✅ Passed | PR modifies only TypeScript/JavaScript React components in web/src/components/. OTE Binary Stdout Contract check is for Go binaries and is not applicable. | | Ipv6 And Disconnected Network Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | PR modifies only TypeScript/React hook files in web frontend; no new Ginkgo e2e tests added, so IPv6 and disconnected network compatibility check is not applicable. | | Title check | ✅ Passed | The title '[OU-1307](https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/OU-1307): don't fight console to setActiveNamespace' directly reflects the main change: removing calls to setActiveNamespace to avoid fighting the console's namespace/route synchronization loop. |
✏️ Tip: You can configure your own custom pre-merge checks in the settings.
